newsitem.title: UK: Iraq tells OPEC it over quota in Jan, Iran in line.
newsitem.headline: Iraq tells OPEC it over quota in Jan, Iran in line.

text.p: Iraq told OPEC it produced and supplied 1.34 million barrels per day (bpd) to the market in January, well in excess of its 1.2 million bpd quota, the OPEC News Agency said on Wednesday.
Iran, however, said it produced and supplied 3.596 million bpd in January, slightly below its quota of 3.6 million, OPECNA said.
The United Arab Emirates (UAE), meanwhile, said it produced 2.227 million bpd but supplied only 2.16 million to the market, exactly in line with its OPEC quota.
Algeria told OPEC production and supply, at 795,000 bpd and 789,000 bpd respectively, were both in excess of its 750,000 bpd ceiling.
Supply, as defined by OPEC, is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
